In short: DB column names in Identity, Attempt and Billing now match canon-data. Portal UI now talks to utility-service through the gateway for translations and tenant-site files, and the main flows are tested. Also drafted an OpenAPI writing guide for MCP use.

1. Done today
   1. EIT-8371 – Database column renames to match canon-data
      - Added forward migrations only. Old migrations were not changed.
      - Identity: 36 columns renamed.
      - Attempt: 9 columns renamed.
      - Billing: 47 columns renamed.
      - API / OpenAPI field names stay the same. Callers still use the old JSON names.
      - SQL, seeds and DB docs now use the new column names.
   2. EIT-8372 – Connect portal-ui to utility-service through api-gateway
      - Translation management now uses `/api/v1/*` instead of ei-localization.
      - Tenant-site contract upload and list now use `/api/v1/files`.
      - UI models stay the same. A mapper converts the new responses.
      - utility-service now returns the coverage stats and lookup value IDs the UI needs.
      - Duplicate translation value now returns 409, not 500.
      - Fixed two bugs found while testing:
        - CSL order search by tenant name.
        - False "1 Mismatch Found" in contract comparison (grade `5` vs `"Grade 5"`).
   3. Testing for the utility-service work
      - portal-ui: 966 / 966 tests pass; build passes.
      - api-gateway: 297 / 297 tests pass.
      - utility-service: build, vet and tests pass.
      - Translation end-to-end through the gateway: 40 / 40 pass.
      - Manual checks: tenant-site contract upload, CRM / Shiksha lead docs, and the main sales flows.
   4. Created `openapi-spec-writing-guide.md` as a knowledge document for OpenAPI writing, to be used with an MCP. Will discuss this with Rahul.
